state.persona: Anonymous first-time visitor to dope.travel (a travel discovery site), on an iPhone-sized phone, no account, no prior knowledge of the product vocabulary. Wants to find a place worth going to, understand why and how far, and keep it for later.
state.job: Having found Oktoberfest in Munich, take the next step toward actually going.
state.workflow: On the Munich destination page (phone). First screen shows: A PLACE WORTH THE JOURNEY, Munich, one big glowing orange gradient button 'Start a trip ↗' (the only gradient button on screen) and a secondary 'Get a feel for it ↓'. A sticky pill at the bottom says 'Plan Oktoberfest'. Save this event is about 3 phone screens further down.
state.what_happens_on_tap: Start a trip opens a Circles page: 'Trip rooms. A Circle is a trip, not a chat thread. Live Circles still live in Community for members who are signed in.' It shows the chosen occasion and 'No Circle or booking has been created', then a button 'Continue in Community to start a real Circle ↗'. The Community page then says membership is not connected in this preview; there is no sign-in available.

expectation.instructions: Before tapping, what does the user most likely expect 'Start a trip' to do?

criteria.trip_plan: Open a personal trip plan or itinerary for Munich they can build alone
criteria.group_room: Create a group room to plan with friends

reaches_outcome.instructions: Probability the user gets any usable trip-planning outcome by following Start a trip and its continuation links in this preview.

cta_honesty.instructions: Is giving this CTA the single most prominent style on the page appropriate given what it leads to?
criteria: Inappropriate: the most prominent action leads to an unavailable flow

legend.0: Inappropriate: the most prominent action leads to an unavailable flow
